description: This PHP source file defines the CopyActivityModel class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin API. The class models the data structure for copying project activities, including properties for project activities from a specific project and duplicated activities. It provides a constructor to initialize these properties and a toArray method to serialize the data into an array format suitable for API responses.

classes.name: CopyActivityModel
classes.description: A model class representing the data for copying project activities, including the ability to serialize its data into an array format for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CopyActivityModel with arrays of project activities from a project and duplicated activities.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the model data into an associative array, mapping activity names to IDs and indicating whether each activity is unique.
